name: orgmymiam
description: PWA Offline-First de planification de repas et liste de courses

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orgmymiam/shared && npm run build -w @orgmymiam/api && npm run build -w @orgmymiam/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orgmymiam/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orgmymiam/api && npm run typecheck -w @orgmymiam/web
